d: As a member of Schneider Electric’s Corporate Legal Team, you will join a collaborative group of in-house lawyers and legal professionals. The Global Corporate Governance Team is seeking Legal Counsel based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, to provide corporate governance and legal entity support for Schneider Electric Group entities in the Middle East and Africa.

Manage regional corporate governance for Schneider Electric entities in the Middle East and Africa, including oversight of Mercator by Citco and other external corporate governance service providers or law firms, as well as related budgets and spend.
Ensure corporate books, minute books, registers, and statutory records are maintained accurately and consistently for Schneider Electric subsidiaries in the region.
Maintain corporate governance libraries, including regional materials and templates for Middle East and Africa entities.
Maintain and update DiliTrust Governance, including routine and custom reports as requested.
Prepare all governance-related documents and coordinate meetings of boards of directors, managers, shareholders, partners, and other governing bodies as required.
Ensure Schneider Electric entities comply with applicable regulatory and statutory requirements, as well as internal Schneider Electric policies and procedures.

Coordinate Middle East and Africa-specific corporate legal compliance activities, including annual filings, license renewals, beneficial ownership and economic substance reporting, corporate registrations, director and officer changes, powers of attorney, and other jurisdiction-specific statutory requirements.
Support legal entity lifecycle matters across the region, including incorporations, internal restructurings, mergers, liquidations, dissolutions, and branch establishments or deregistrations.

Support Schneider Electric’s M&A and Innovation Teams with acquisitions, divestitures, minority investments, entity creation, corporate due diligence, antitrust filing information, and post-acquisition integration activities.

Serve as the Regional Corporate Governance and Corporate Legal contact for the Middle East and Africa, partnering with Schneider Electric’s Business Legal, Business Leadership, Finance, Tax, Treasury, HR, Compliance, Procurement, Real Estate, and other stakeholders on governance initiatives and legal entity projects.
Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting Schneider Electric entities in the Middle East and Africa and provide practical guidance on governance implications and compliance requirements.
Support legal entity and data governance initiatives by maintaining accurate information in DiliTrust Governance and contributing to process improvements, controls, and reporting.
Provide training and help develop templates, policies, procedures, playbooks, and other governance resources.
Perform other related duties and ad hoc projects as required.
q: Law degree with a focus on corporate law, business law, or a related field.

Ideally 2+ years of relevant experience in corporate governance, corporate secretarial work, corporate law, or legal entity management, gained within a law firm, multinational corporation, or professional services firm.
Experience supporting entities across multiple jurisdictions, preferably in the Middle East.
Strong drafting, project management, advisory, analytical, and communication skills, with curiosity, responsiveness, and willingness to work in a large international environment.
Ability to work independently and as part of a global team.
Flexibility to work with colleagues in other countries and, on occasion, accommodate calls and deadlines aligned to other time zones.
High integrity, sound business judgment, discretion, credibility, and professional ethics.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, Adobe, DiliTrust Governance, or similar subsidiary management tools.
Written and spoken Arabic and English are mandatory. Written and spoken French preferred.
Bring your legal expertise to a team that's ready to welcome you — apply today!

d: The Business Development Manager- AI & Agents is responsible for building and owning a fully self-sourced new-business pipeline for AI Agents, AI Apps, and AI Models across the assigned markets, converting qualified opportunity into signed revenue.

The role requires a consultative, diagnosis-first business development professional who can navigate complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, build stakeholder maps and account plans, and translate operational pain points into specific, relevant AI use cases. The role applies structured, disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent) and works both directly and through the company’s channel and partner ecosystem to close new business.
q: Own full-cycle prospecting, qualification, and closing across an assigned account territory within the UAE market.
Build and own a fully self-sourced, hunter-owned pipeline — no inherited pipeline, no renewals, and no account management.
Apply structured, disciplined qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent), qualifying in and disqualifying out with equal rigor.
Consistently work toward and achieve assigned business development and revenue targets.
Identify decision-makers, influencers, buying centers, and potential entry points within target organizations.
Take full ownership of assigned target accounts and conduct comprehensive account research that feeds live account plans, not a standalone exercise.
Build and maintain account plans and stakeholder maps for a defined target account list (NAL).
Develop a strong understanding of each target account, including business model, technology landscape, procurement structures, and key stakeholders.
Translate a client’s operational pain points into specific, relevant AI Agents, AI Apps, and AI Models use cases.
Research a prospect’s business, technology, and recent moves thoroughly before any first meeting.
Conduct proactive outbound prospecting through multiple channels, including calls, email, LinkedIn, networking, events, referrals, and industry connections.
Generate and co-develop pipeline together with Marketing through account-based marketing (ABM) efforts.
Generate and manage pipeline in partnership with the company’s channel and partner ecosystem.
Lead prospecting at industry exhibitions and events using a pre-built target list, rather than general floor-walking.
Qualify opportunities based on business need, commercial potential, buying authority, timing, and fit.
Understand the prospect's business challenges and translate them into potential technology solutions.
Develop compelling commercial propositions, proposals, and presentations in collaboration with relevant internal teams.
Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and deal progression.
Own opportunities from initial prospecting through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and closure.
Close deals directly or indirectly through strategic partnerships and channel relationships.
Leverage partnerships to access new markets, accounts, and opportunities.
Clearly articulate the business value, ROI, and impact of proposed technology solutions.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospects, activities, opportunities, and deal stages in the CRM.
Provide regular visibility on pipeline value, forecast, conversion rates, activities, and expected closures.
Ensure disciplined follow-up and progression of opportunities.
Analyze pipeline performance and continuously improve prospecting and conversion approaches.
Work closely with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Production, Products, finance, Legal, and other relevant functions to ensure commercial commitments are realistic and deliverable.
Coordinate internally to develop customized solutions and proposals for prospects.
Ensure a smooth transition from closed opportunity to implementation and account ownership.
Attend industry exhibitions and conferences relevant to AI Agents, Apps, and Models, using a pre-built target list to drive prospecting.
Develop and maintain client relationships, expectations & satisfaction, understanding how systems integrators, hyperscalers, and channel partners fit around a deal.
Conduct regular in-person meetings with UAE-based clients and stakeholders to strengthen relationships.
A bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred.
At least 8 years of proven experience in business development, technology sales, solution sales, enterprise sales, or consultative B2B sales.
Experience selling technology, digital, AI, SaaS, cloud, automation, software, IT services, or other technology-enabled solutions.
Management consulting background (e.g., Big 4, strategy firm) is a strong plus, bringing diagnostic rigor and business-case skills.
Demonstrated track record of acquiring new clients and closing B2B deals.
Experience managing a defined target-account list and developing account penetration strategies.
Excellent prospecting, networking, negotiation, and closing skills.
Comfortable with long, technical, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
Strong commercial acumen and ability to identify revenue opportunities.
Excellent account research and business intelligence skills.
Ability to understand client needs and translate them into relevant Tech solutions.
Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Highly target-driven and comfortable working with ambitious sales targets.
Resilient, persistent, and able to handle rejection and setbacks.
Excellent level of proficiency with MS Office Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English.
Willingness to travel approximately 25–50% to UAE, typically involving one to two business trips per month, depending on business requirements.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Jira Administrator to manage the Atlassian Jira Cloud at Canonical, including the administration, configuration, automation, and integration responsibilities. We expect the highest engineering quality, rigorous documentation practices, and effective stakeholder management abilities. Our goal is to enable Canonical engineering and business teams to leverage the power of Atlassian Jira, work on challenging assignments, and enable teams to make data-driven decisions.

The role is in the Commercial Systems team that integrates business systems used at Canonical to ensure reliable data flows at the right time to the right place, and to automate business processes across the company. We own a wide range of systems including popular SaaS solutions, such as Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, Greenhouse, GSuite, and a few dozen others. To achieve this goal, we leverage Python and Go in combination with open source tools, such as Airbyte and Temporal. Our work helps to make data-driven decisions, and increases the efficiency of business operations.
Location: This role can be held anywhere in EMEA time zones.
Manage Atlassian Jira Cloud at Canonical
Design, document, and implement processes and automation in Jira
Design, document, and implement integrations between Jira and the data warehouse
Create analytical dashboards to enable stakeholders make data-driven decisions
Work with engineering, operations, and support teams at a global scale
Take ownership of critical escalations and resolve them in a timely manner
q: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Experience with Atlassian Jira and its ecosystem as an administrator
Understanding of common Jira usage patterns for various technical and non-technical departments
Experience as a software developer in Python
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Ability to collaborate remotely with a diverse set of team members and stakeholders, remain highly motivated, productive, and organized in a fully remote environment
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
